say:1:1360219001:0.text: After a fierce battle, the corruption has been purified. You tell Soren and Shakir about Berial's scheme.
say:1:1360219001:0.source_cn: 一番激战后，异常总算被净化了，你们也告知了贝利尔的阴谋...

say:3:1360219002:1.text: All in all, you two have been deceived by Berial!
say:3:1360219002:1.source_cn: 所以说，你们两个就是这样被贝利尔那家伙诱骗啦！

say:4:1360219003:0.text: Why did Berial choose them as targets?
say:4:1360219003:0.source_cn: 不过，为什么会是沙奎尔和索恩两个人呢？

choice_prompt:5:1360219003.text: Why did Berial choose them as targets?
choice_prompt:5:1360219003.source_cn: 不过，为什么会是沙奎尔和索恩两个人呢？

say:6:1360219004:0.text: Is it because Shakir's gullible... *Cough* I mean, grumpy?
say:6:1360219004:0.source_cn: 是因为沙奎尔比较好骗……咳咳，好斗！好斗，所以更容易陷...
say:6:1360219004:0.male: Is it because Shakir's gullible... *Cough* I mean, grumpy?
say:6:1360219004:0.female: Is it because Shakir's gullible... *Cough* I mean, grumpy?

say:7:1360219005:0.text: He's always been impulsive, so it's easy to predict his movements.
say:7:1360219005:0.source_cn: 他又一直是风风火火的个性，能很轻松地把握行踪，所以被选...
say:7:1360219005:0.male: He's always been impulsive, so it's easy to predict his movements.
say:7:1360219005:0.female: He's always been impulsive, so it's easy to predict his movements.

say:8:1360219007:1.text: Soren, you said you were practicing on your <style="highlight">war drum</style>, right?
say:8:1360219007:1.source_cn: 索恩，我记得你之前说过，你离开氏族是<style=hi...

say:9:1360219008:1.text: Yes. It's a tradition of ours to play drums and horns during the duels between the desert clans.
say:9:1360219008:1.source_cn: 是的，沙漠这边各个氏族时常会有比武，以战鼓、号角之类的...

say:10:1360219009:1.text: Alsa and I, as representatives of the Uru Clan, must learn to play one of these instruments.
say:10:1360219009:1.source_cn: 我与阿尔萨如今代表乌尔氏族，这类乐器也需要选一种开始练习。

say:11:1360219010:1.text: Why did you have to practice outside? Is it because you didn't want to disturb anyone?
say:11:1360219010:1.source_cn: 那你为什么要到外面来？是因为在氏族太吵了吗？

say:12:1360219011:1.text: Yeah, the kids thought my drum sounded strange.
say:12:1360219011:1.source_cn: 嗯，小孩子们说，“索恩的鼓声很奇怪”“听起来不像鼓”，...

say:13:1360219012:1.text: I can't really tell, but Alsa said the same thing.
say:13:1360219012:1.source_cn: 我分辨不太出来，但阿尔萨也这么说。

say:14:1360219013:1.text: I suspected the drumhead absorbed too much moisture, so I moved it to a drier spot to test the sound.
say:14:1360219013:1.source_cn: 我想，是不是鼓面在水源附近受潮了，所以在干燥的地方试音。

say:15:1360219014:1.text: But I still didn't notice anything wrong.
say:15:1360219014:1.source_cn: 但是，我并没有发现什么不对。

say:16:1360219015:1.text: Tired of explaining, Soren taps the drum several times, and the sound comes out just fine.
say:16:1360219015:1.source_cn: 似乎是不愿再继续解释，索恩迅速地敲了几下战鼓，但声音听...

say:17:1360219016:1.text: There's really nothing wrong with the sound...
say:17:1360219016:1.source_cn: 确实啊，这只是普通的鼓声……

say:18:1360219017:1.text: However, when I was drumming outside earlier, the unpleasant energy in the air seemed to dissipate.
say:18:1360219017:1.source_cn: 不过，在外面敲鼓时我注意到，似乎有让人不太舒服的不祥气...

choice_prompt:19:1360219017.text: However, when I was drumming outside earlier, the unpleasant energy in the air seemed to dissipate.
choice_prompt:19:1360219017.source_cn: 不过，在外面敲鼓时我注意到，似乎有让人不太舒服的不祥气息消失了。

say:20:1360219018:1.text: Do you mean the <style="highlight">Dusk Lord's blessing</style> Alsa and I received earlier can dispel Berial's magic?
say:20:1360219018:1.source_cn: 你是说，我与阿尔萨此前受到的<style=highli...
say:20:1360219018:1.male: Do you mean the <style="highlight">Dusk Lord's blessing</style> Alsa and I received earlier can dispel Berial's magic?
say:20:1360219018:1.female: Do you mean the <style="highlight">Dusk Lord's blessing</style> Alsa and I received earlier can dispel Berial's magic?

say:21:1360219019:1.text: After all, it's just some apparitions Berial conjured up. I wouldn't be surprised if the god's blessing can dispel them.
say:21:1360219019:1.source_cn: 唔，毕竟是神的祝福，贝利尔那家伙又只是投入了几个邪影，...

say:22:1360219020:1.text: Yet, the sound was still distorted when Soren played the drum at the clan. This means the blessing alone isn't enough to counter the magic.
say:22:1360219020:1.source_cn: 只是，索恩在氏族内击鼓时，那里的声音还是出现了扭曲，就...

say:23:1360219021:1.text: If we don't do something about it quickly, the clan could end up like the Frozen Paw soon.
say:23:1360219021:1.source_cn: 如果不及时驱除的话，说不定会变得像白熊温泉旅店那样啊。

say:25:1360219022:1.text: I have an idea. I noticed you were holding an odd-looking clock just now.
say:25:1360219022:1.source_cn: 我倒有个想法，对手啊，你刚刚不是拿了个奇怪的魔法钟吗？
say:25:1360219022:1.male: I have an idea. I noticed you were holding an odd-looking clock just now.
say:25:1360219022:1.female: I have an idea. I noticed you were holding an odd-looking clock just now.

say:26:1360219023:1.text: That clock is incredible! Just its chimes alone were capable of subduing those nasty creatures.
say:26:1360219023:1.source_cn: 那个钟敲两下，铛铛铛的几声，就施展出了魔法，把那些乱七...

say:26:1360219023:1.female: That clock is incredible! Just its chimes alone were capable of subduing those nasty creatures.

say:27:1360219024:1.text: This fellow has some kind of magic too, right? We should figure out a way to spread his magic like the clock. What if we get him to tap his drum?

say:28:1360219025:1.source_cn: 反正他手里拿着棍子，敲的是钟是鼓还是石头也没啥区别吧？
say:28:1360219025:1.male: His drum isn't here, but he's got a stick. I suppose it doesn't matter if he taps a clock, a drum, or even a rock, right?
say:28:1360219025:1.female: His drum isn't here, but he's got a stick. I suppose it doesn't matter if he taps a clock, a drum, or even a rock, right?

choice_prompt:29:1360219025.female: His drum isn't here, but he's got a stick. I suppose it doesn't matter if he taps a clock, a drum, or even a rock, right?

say:30:1360219026:1.source_cn: 你这若有所思的表情，哈哈哈，对手，你也被我的智慧启发了吗！
say:30:1360219026:1.male: Look at your face... I said something brilliant, didn't I?
say:30:1360219026:1.female: Look at your face... I said something brilliant, didn't I?

say:31:1360219027:1.source_cn: 沙奎尔虽然毫无魔法常识，但直觉却很准确……

say:32:1360219030:1.text: Either way, let's give my idea a shot!
say:32:1360219030:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，既然对手你在这里，现在就试试看吧！

say:36:1360221001:0.female: Soon, you finish drawing a rune on a piece of paper.

say:38:1360221002:0.text: The strokes, simple at first glance, have the power to awaken sacred energy when combined with different sounds.
say:38:1360221002:0.source_cn: 它笔法看似简单，却能够深层唤醒神圣的力量，而唤醒它的元...

say:38:1360221002:0.female: The strokes, simple at first glance, have the power to awaken sacred energy when combined with different sounds.

say:40:1360221003:1.text: Can this rune, along with the sound of a drum or horn, awaken the purifying power?
say:40:1360221003:1.source_cn: 这符文，以及使用鼓声或者号角声，就是唤醒净化力量的关键？

say:41:1360221004:1.text: The rune will work when you draw it on your instruments.
say:41:1360221004:1.source_cn: 没错，只需要描绘在相应的乐器上，你和阿尔萨演奏出声音，...

say:42:1360221005:1.text: Using sound as the trigger means you won't have to keep draining your own energy.
say:42:1360221005:1.source_cn: 用声音作为启动条件，也是为了避免一直激发你们体内的力量...

say:44:1360221007:1.text: Even though the purification method has been discovered, more must be done since Berial's influence goes beyond just one place.
say:44:1360221007:1.source_cn: 尽管有了净化的手段，但贝利尔的污染绝不会仅局限于一时一地。

say:45:1360221008:1.text: Aside from purification, precise reconnaissance is just as crucial...
say:45:1360221008:1.source_cn: 因此，除去净化外，敏锐而准确的侦查也不可或缺——

say:47:1360221009:1.text: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
say:47:1360221009:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈，果然还是要拜托我啊，对手！
say:47:1360221009:1.male: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
say:47:1360221009:1.female: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!

choice_prompt:48:1360221009.text: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!

choice_prompt:48:1360221009.male: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!
choice_prompt:48:1360221009.female: Hahaha, seems like you need my help!

say:49:1360221010:1.text: Consider it done! I'm wise enough to be your magic advisor, you know?
say:49:1360221010:1.source_cn: 放心吧，如今的我已经是能为你提供魔法建议的我了！

say:49:1360221010:1.female: Consider it done! I'm wise enough to be your magic advisor, you know?

say:52:1360221012:0.text: Just don't get led into a fight again...
say:52:1360221012:0.source_cn: 话是这么说，可不要一不小心又被人引去打架了呀。

say:53:1360221013:1.text: Um... that's no doubt a tough promise to keep. After all, this place is full of interesting people I can combat with!
say:53:1360221013:1.source_cn: 呃……在我可敬的对手面前，我也没法否认，毕竟这里到处都...

say:54:1360221014:1.text: Plus, fighting is my only passion...
say:54:1360221014:1.source_cn: 而且我对战斗以外的事务完全没有任何兴趣……

say:55:1360221015:1.text: I'm only doing this for you, my respected adversary. I'll honor my promise!
say:55:1360221015:1.source_cn: 但，毕竟是我可敬对手的嘱托，我就必然会完成，放心吧，沙...

say:56:1360221016:1.text: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!
say:56:1360221016:1.source_cn: 只是，如果一切顺利，别忘了再回来与我比武啊，对手！
say:56:1360221016:1.male: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!
say:56:1360221016:1.female: Once this is all over, you must spar with me!

say:57:1360221017:1.text: Let's have a proper duel next time!

say:59:1360221018:1.source_cn: 接下来，我也会把情况通知给布鲁特斯大人那边，让周边都警...
